description: A foreign part inside another foreign part gives nothing of its own, since the outer one counts once: `outer` holds `inner` and sounds one `?`. Two sibling foreign parts are two parts, so `whole` sounds `??` and its label joins their texts (engine §5, §11).

documents.g.md:
```jbogenbau %ambiguity-resolution greedy %rule text [part] ... %rule part letter | pause | mark %rule letter 'a' | 'b' | 'c' | 'd' %emits $ %rule pause ' '

%emits $ %rule mark '!' ```
documents.h.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $o(outer) P $w(whole)
%emits $o <O>, $w <W>
%rule outer inner L
%foreign
%rule inner L L
%foreign
%rule whole inner inner
%emits $
```
